notes: Official OpenAPI 3.1 document, version 1.1.0, pinned by SHA-256. All 20 action requests and both webhook lifecycle requests were checked against it.

Webhook event fixtures copy the provider guide. Comments and trailing commas were removed; the explicitly documented Conversation Attributes and Contact/User Object spreads were expanded. Placeholder values were preserved, not replaced with invented events.
All three webhook triggers pass registration, documented HMAC-SHA256 delivery, payload field evidence, agent event resolution, and unregistration checks.
Message delivery defaults to incoming customer messages; outgoing replies require an explicit direction change.
Unsigned older Chatwoot versions are refused and their registrations removed. The guide recommends rejecting timestamps older than five minutes.
No working Chatwoot account or token was present in the task environment; validation uses the published contract and provider examples, with no account creation or sign-in.
The api_access_token header supports existing Chatwoot releases; the latest spec also offers Bearer authentication starting with v4.19.0.
